ask.description:
Chat with the assistant: ask about the weather in a city, ask it to remember something,
or ask something ambiguous and it will ask you back.

Notes.description: What the user asked the agent to remember, shown live in the console's state pane.
Notes.title: Notes

TextMessage.description: Free-form natural-language text from the user (the input to a plain chat handler).
TextMessage.title: TextMessage

TextReply.description: A free-form natural-language reply (the output of a plain chat handler).
TextReply.title: TextReply
